data.one_liner: Prevents screenshots and screen recordings on Android, iOS, and Windows.
data.what_it_does: This plugin sets platform‑specific flags to block screenshot and screen recording. It also provides a callback to detect when a recording starts on iOS.
use_when: Protecting sensitive screens in banking or health apps
Preventing screen capture in secure admin panels
avoid_when: Apps that need to allow users to capture the screen for sharing
Applications that rely on screen recording for tutorials
strengths: Simple API with a single enable/disable method
weaknesses: Does not support macOS or Linux
May not work on older Windows versions lacking SetWindowDisplayAffinity
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, run flutter pub get. On Android add the FLAG_SECURE permission in AndroidManifest.xml if needed. No build_runner or native code changes required.
